Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Ellis (CTO) — tom.ellis@meridianhealth.com. He’ll want a short one-pager on cost upside and SLAs.
- Procurement: procurement@meridianhealth.com handles contracts/POs and typically needs 4–6 weeks for CNAs/PO issuance after legal signoff.
- RFI: attaching our Vendor_RFI.xlsx — it covers SOC2, encryption, data residency, and subcontractors. Please fill and return.

On decision criteria:
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens) for the inference path used by clinicians. For longer batch-ish jobs (>=512 tokens) we can tolerate up to 1s p95.
- Deployment mode: Preference is private (VPC) due to PHI and data residency rules — we may consider a dedicated hosted lane for non-PHI but assume private for the core workflow.
- SLA expectations: uptime 99.9% with clear escalation contacts and an SLO to avoid impact to clinician workflows.
- Budget: rough target operating expense is ~$1,500–3,000 per month for proof-of-concept traffic; scale economics will be reviewed by Tom.

We’re time-boxed: security review and procurement loop needs to be complete before Oct 15 to make the Q4 pilot cutoff.

Claire

Neha / Claire — quick take from SE perspective: 

1) Feasibility: 200ms p95 for <=128 tokens is achievable on Redwood Dedicated or Private with a small GPU pool and appropriate batching/caching. For a pilot (low concurrency), recommend: 1 x A10G-equivalent instance with continuous batching disabled for clinician-facing low-latency path, plus a small inference cache for repeated prompts. Expected p95 range: 120–220ms depending on prompt size and model choice; we should target a medium-sized LLM (7B-13B) quantized to int8 for best latency-cost tradeoff.

2) Deployment: Private (VPC) will satisfy PHI/residency requirements. Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in our infra) is an alternative if they want managed hardware without self-hosting; hosted multi-tenant is not recommended for PHI workflows.

3) Security/legal asks: SOC2 artifacts are standard; we can provide SOC2 summary and DPA template immediately. For data residency, we can confirm region-specific deployment and provide contact for KMS/HSM integration. Stephanie — I flagged the RFI items that typically need legal/enterprise signoff.

4) Next steps & timing: I’ll assemble an operations latency table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and a rough cost estimate for the pilot and a scaled 10x scenario by EOD tomorrow (8/31). Recommend a 30-minute call with Tom + Claire to align econ/ops — propose Mon 9/6 10:00am PT or Tue 9/7 9:00am PT.

Happy to jump on a short screen share to walk through numbers.

— Karthik
